body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 77f402386fdb50bef1b3527ecfa177799efd8bd1 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge - the PR no longer merges with `main` (conflicts); the code itself is clean.**

**What looks good**
- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in `recognize/` or `mcp/pockets.rs`; every index goes through `.get()` (e.g. `walls.rs:99,106,141,167,207`), casts are guarded (`mcp/pockets.rs:63`), and `operation_for` refuses a non-finite or zero depth or width by name (`recognize/op.rs:36,50`). `degenerate_input_refuses_cleanly` covers an unknown model, NaN/inf/zero-area facets and a torn mesh.
- Gouge question: a Slot is only chosen when no closed end is square (`op.rs:17`), so a round cap never stands in for a sharp corner; open ends run out past the floor edge into stock or air, not into the part; an open pocket is a Pocket on the floor face, so the part's own rings bound the cut. Tests check the path stays inside the ring and generates with no Gouge.
- Provenance lines present, new files all under 400 lines, decision record in `docs/decisions/`, no CHANGELOG edit, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #35`, no deps/build.rs/scripts/.github touched.

**Local results (PR head, debug; NOT merged with main because of the conflicts)**

| suite | result |
|---|---|
| pocket_recognition | 10 passed |
| mcp_pockets | 3 passed |
| mcp | 13 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge conflicts with `main` in three registration lists, all "keep both sides":
   - `crates/app/src/lib.rs` (`pub mod recognize;` vs `pub mod raster;`),
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs` (`mod pockets;` vs `mod render;`),
   - `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:9` (`use super::{..., pockets}` vs `render`; the tool table likely needs both too).
   Please `git merge origin/main`, re-run the quick gate, push. The PR is turned back into a draft meanwhile.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- As the PR says, a recognised Slot cannot post until #510 is fixed (round-cap gouge false positive); that is a refusal, not a silent wrong path, so it is safe.
- A Slot is authored from the stock source (judgement call 3); if the cutter is wider than the slot, please confirm the Slot op refuses it by name (not exercised in this review).
- This is a `feat`, so it merges at the next cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
